ns2:section.sectionText: This section will follow a complete asynchronous format. It will have asynchronous recorded videos covering course content. Additional interactive activities will be available for asynchronous completion. Students that are not planning to attend synchronous lectures should register to this section. If needed, we will provide time-conflict overrides. All the available course content, assignments and exams will be identical for both sections. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
